payload.core_mechanism_summary: Right-to-left DP where a[i] stores index of min-cost j>i with s_j>s_i, using precomputed best k for each j to form triples; heap tracks min total cost.
payload.rationale: Core logic is 1D DP: state a[i] optimal next index with larger size and minimal cost. Heap is auxiliary for answer extraction. Matches dp_1d_state.
